newsitem.title: JAPAN: Peugeot sees higher Japan sales in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Peugeot sees higher Japan sales in 1997.

text.p: Inchcape Peugeot Japan Co Ltd, the Japanese unit of Automobiles Peugeot, hopes to sell 7,000 Peugeot cars in Japan in 1997, a spokesman said on Friday.
Sales of Peugeot cars in the January to September period rose six percent from a year earlier to 3,129, according to industry data.
Peugeot Japan also said it had launched the Peugeot 406, a right-hand-drive luxury sedan, in Japan as the successor to the Peugeot 405.
The 406 models will sell for between 2.99 million yen and 3.59 million yen, about the same prices as for the 405.
